Book unchanged: HL perps FLAT, ~$18.17 HL spot + $10.33 SOL book. Mandate caps intact. Alex: the L1 clock workflow paste remains the one human action owed.

## 2. Overnight / weekend world read (verified outside the bus)
**CRYPTO — the falsifier SURVIVES its sharpest test; the probes keep deepening.** SOL: Oct-17 REVISED UP to 103.31 (provisional was 103.08 on the plugin pull / 102.69 on the cached Yahoo page) — the straddle RESOLVES upward, the $103 hard falsifier holds on the revision, and the cached page is confirmed stale. Oct-18 (Sun) closed 103.83 (+0.50% d/d) BUT printed intraday low 100.64 — the FOURTH probe below $103 and the deepest yet (sequence: 101.03 / 102.65 / 101.43 / 100.64). Fifth consecutive close below 105.84 (104.07 / 105.33 / 104.30r / 103.31r / 103.83). The closes-contract is intact; the level is being auctioned. BTC: the eight-consecutive-downward-revision streak BROKE — Oct-17 revised UP +82.87 to 81,382.15; Oct-18 closed 81,701.94 (+0.39%); 30th revised / 31st provisional session above 78,900. ETH: Oct-17 revised up to 2,399.80; Oct-18 closed 2,392.69 (-0.30%). ETF flows: no Farside rows over the weekend; October MTD stands ~-$614.7M; next row Monday.

**OIL — fired leg day 8: the reopen FADES a fresh mine claim.** BZ=F Sunday-Globex row (thin, vol 498): O 110.25 / H 110.25 / L 108.75 / forming 108.83 — -0.94% vs Friday's revised 109.86 settle, still +4.11 over the 104.72 firing settle; the leg holds. CL=F forming 98.22 (-3.2% vs revised 101.41 — a near-exact mirror giveback of Friday's +2.37 upward revision). GC=F forming 4,197.30 (+0.4%). NEW WEEKEND INCIDENT: IRGC claimed via ISNA (Oct-18) that an "illegal supertanker" carrying >2M bbl was hit by a SEA MINE transiting Hormuz — explosion and severe fire claimed; UKMTO's weekly review cites 135 total incidents; US counter-framing: 97% of ships transit safely. The tape faded the claim — the market is discriminating claimed-vs-confirmed, or the policy-supply overhang (SPR 17M / IEA diesel) is capping the bid. Volume artifacts: BZ=F dup persists on Oct-15/16 (54,248 both — fourteenth artifact cycle); CL=F dup 222,965; GC=F dup 159,510.

**FED — December bleeds; Kalshi's internal gap CLOSED.** DeFi Rate relay (Kalshi/Polymarket aggregate, observed Oct-18 1:32–6:01pm ET): October hike ~13–14% / hold 87% / cut ~2% — stable. December-9 hike 77% — down from 80% Saturday and 12pts under Thursday's CME 89%: last cycle's condition ("if the gap holds into Monday's CME print, call it drift") goes live tomorrow. Kalshi's same-exchange disagreement RESOLVED: decision market 13.5% vs rate-level 14.5% — the 4pt gap closed in ~24h as expected, the rate-level market moving UP to meet the decision market. Kalshi and Polymarket agree on a 2026 hike ~79.5%. Blackout runs to Oct 27–28; September PCE lands Oct-29.

**RIYADH — 26 hours past deadline, silence.** The NOTAM expired 2100 GMT Oct-17; no GACA reopen-or-extend announcement found this cycle (SafeAirspace Level 1 Do-Not-Fly stands). The first post-deadline Houthi claim — or its absence — remains the tell; none surfaced in this sweep. HORMUZ: beyond the mine claim, no new UKMTO-numbered incident surfaced this cycle.

**ALPENGLOW T-2 — and a pipeline data-hygiene warning.** Mainnet-beta activation Wed Oct-21 ~14:50 UTC (epoch 1064; QuickNode maintenance window 14:50–17:50 UTC). Validators must run Agave v4.3.0; Firedancer/Frankendancer operators switch clients temporarily (Jito fork warning). FOR THE SIGNAL PIPELINE: after the switch, validator vote transactions leave blocks entirely — Solana on-chain transaction-count series will print a mechanical DROP that is NOT reduced user activity. Any on-chain activity signal must be re-based at epoch 1064 or it will false-positive a demand collapse Wednesday afternoon.

**Data-path check:** Binance 31st check — DISCONNECTED: (BTCUSDT,SOLUSDT,ETHUSDT) returned EMPTY_DATA, all symbol queries failed — escalation from the 30th check's degraded/partial (SOL leg 451). Paper-tape-survives-451 clause in play; the Yahoo complex is the tape of record this cycle — single-source dependence noted. Kalshi direct still blocked, tenth cycle; DeFi Rate relay substituted.

## 3. Interrogation notes
- No new thesis on the bus to interrogate, thirty-sixth cycle. Nova CONCUR/VETO queue unchanged (argus_002, argus_003, T-2026-09-11-001 post-hoc, orbital_001) — thirty-ninth cycle on the oldest. Idle-task per PROMPT_FOR_ARGUS: nothing new unfalsified from orbital or nova since Sep-11; the standing unfalsified set is the queue above.
- Self-interrogation, scored: (1) **THE REVISION RESOLVED UPWARD** — both crypto rows under test revised UP (SOL 103.08p->103.31r; BTC 81,299.28p->81,382.15r). Last cycle's calibration ("provisional crypto closes biased +0.1–0.2% rich") FAILED this test — on down-drift days the provisional printed conservative. New working rule: provisional closes on violent down-legs are biased toward caution, same pattern as re-fire-day settles; the downward-revision drift was BTC-specific, and it just broke. (2) **THE LEVEL IS BEING AUCTIONED, NOT BROKEN** — four probes, each deeper (101.03 -> 100.64), five closes under 105.84, zero revised closes under 103. The contract stands as written. The market has had four intraday chances at the falsifier and cannot hold a close under it — that asymmetry is itself information. (3) **THE STREAK-BREAK MATTERS** — BTC's revision streak was the cleanest bearish microstructure tell on the board; it broke at eight. One up-revision doesn't flip the tape, but "every revision is downward" is dead; treat revision direction as unpatterned until a new run establishes. (4) **CRUDE FADED A MINE CLAIM** — a claimed 2M-bbl mine strike would have gapped Brent two months ago; Sunday's thin tape sold it instead. Either confirmation standards have risen, or policy supply is capping. Discriminating test: Monday's full session vs the 108.75–110.25 Sunday range. (5) **DECEMBER IS THE FIGHT AND IT'S BLEEDING** — 80->77 on the Kalshi relay across 24h; the 12pt CME/Kalshi spread either closes on Monday's CME print (venue artifact) or persists (drift call — December softening with October already priced out).
- External calibration: SOL revised 103.31 vs plugin provisional 103.08 (+0.22%); BTC revised 81,382.15 vs provisional 81,299.28 (+0.10%). DeFi Rate observation window Oct-18 1:32–6:01pm ET — fresh. Binance unavailable for cross-check this cycle (disconnected).

2. RESOLVED: SOL Oct-17 straddle — revised close 103.31 (>103); plugin pull beat the cached page; the falsifier survives. NEW FORM: four deepening intraday probes (100.64 deepest) vs zero revised closes <103 — the auction contradiction.

7. RESOLVED: Kalshi internal 4pt gap — now 13.5% decision vs 14.5% rate-level (1pt), closed upward within ~24h as expected. Kalshi direct block: tenth cycle; DeFi Rate relay.
8. December venue spread WIDENED: CME 89% (Thu) vs Kalshi/Poly 77% (Sun) — 12pts; Monday's CME print adjudicates drift vs venue artifact.
9. Binance 31st check: fully DISCONNECTED (EMPTY_DATA, all symbols) — escalated from degraded/partial.
10. Black Sea shipping silence — eighth week.
11. Tehran reply to the reopening proposal STILL inbound — beyond three weeks; pre-committed trigger (US rejection through the channel + shuttle collapse) NOT fired.
12. ^TNX Oct-12 flat 5.24 zero-volume row — Columbus Day carry artifact (carried).
13. Riyadh NOTAM: +26h past the 2100 GMT Oct-17 deadline; GACA silent; reopen-or-extend unconfirmed.
14. NEW: Alpenglow structural break — post-epoch-1064 SOL transaction counts mechanically drop (vote txs leave blocks); unrebased on-chain signals will false-fire Wednesday.
